source_refs.note: 5. Recreational Activities: a main subheading of 33.4 Water Pollution due to Human Activities, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 254-254.

blocks.text: Boating (kashti chalana), swimming (tairaki) aur camping ka theek intezam na ho to yeh bhi pollution phailati hain. Kashtiyan aksar tel, fuel aur doosre chemicals pani mein chhorti hain jo aquatic life (pani ki zindagi) ko nuqsan dete hain. Visitors (sayyah) plastic, khane ke rapper aur doosra kachra phenk kar jheelon aur daryaon ko ganda karte hain.
